headline: L2 DE-set predictor v0 trained LOSO over 3 label lines (39.2M target-gene rows); AUROC 0.796, operating threshold 0.64 lands covered-target median DE count at 29 (gate band 22-44); lfc_cal EB-shrunk (median ratio 0.51, 93.2% finite)

audit_flags.message: Design gate (median predicted DE count in 22-44 on covered targets) met at threshold 0.64 (median 29). Caveat: predicted counts are on the full-L1 production model, and the per-target spread is wide (IQR 1-188; 20% of covered targets in band) -- a global threshold is a weak per-target calibrator.

Label stores are in different DE-calling regimes from the eval target band: xatlas Welch-per-sample (n<=218) calls ~1,800-2,000 genes DE per target at q<0.05, k562 gem-group Welch calls ~6. The predictor inherits the xatlas-dominated label regime (pos_frac 0.29); k205b candidates: regime-matched labels (downsampled-power or conservative-stat labels), per-target top-K output instead of global threshold, isotonic calibration.

de_prob mass piles just above the 0.5 decision boundary: median count falls 1,174 -> 29 across thr 0.5->0.64. Brier 0.157 is honest; the cliff means small threshold moves swing counts hard -- L3 should consume de_prob as a ranking/weight, not only a hard set.

LOSO protocol verified: features for each label store built from L1 excluding that store (loso-{hct116,hek293t,k562} rebuilt under OUT_ROOT). Labels = within-store q<0.05; the label store never contributes to its own feature row.

notes: Build incidents: (1) kd_eff broadcast to len(cols) then re-sliced by full-axis indices -> IndexError; fixed by broadcasting to full gene axis before column slicing, covered by tests/test_k205_deset.py. (2) npz member access re-decompresses full arrays; _load_feats materializes each member once. Sampled-eval DE counts (234 pred / 300 true) are within the <=900-col label window, not full-axis -- the full-axis audit curve is the gate quantity.
